## What's changed

- Auto-generated Tube TV channels now use only the commercial groups selected
  in Tube TV settings. Leaving every group unchecked keeps commercials out of
  auto-generated channels.
- Added a clear Auto-Channel Commercials label and selection count to the
  Commercials tab so the setting and its empty state are easy to understand.
- Kept built-in Tater bumpers independent from commercial-group selection.
  They continue playing at their normal cadence unless Live TV bumpers are
  disabled separately.
- Preserved the existing commercial selection behavior for user-created
  channels.
